why: A lawyer must immediately see that Jus-Tice has a paid profile/account path, not only consumer legal content.
The plan page should sell visibility, trust, lead follow-up and manual payment bridge before price friction.
First signup should preserve paid intent while keeping account creation understandable.
Until provider approval is complete, the payment path must be honest and still ready for manual link/invoice conversion.
The personal area should feel like the place to manage profile, leads, follow-up and service requests.
Upgrade, downgrade, cancel, refund and support requests need structured capture to avoid owner phone chaos.
Revenue growth needs attribution and funnel event evidence, not only page design.
